newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CELTIC'S VAN HOOYDONK SET TO JOIN FOREST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CELTIC'S VAN HOOYDONK SET TO JOIN FOREST.

text.p: Premier league Nottingham Forest were expected to announce the signing of Glasgow Celtic's Dutch striker Pierre van Hooydonk on Monday for a reported fee of 4.5 million pounds ($7.2 million).
Forest, who have called a news conference for 1400 GMT, are in search of a striker to help lift them out of the relegation zone. They have scored just one goal in their last seven matches.
The club was the subject of a successful takeover bid a week ago which freed up around 16 million pounds ($26 million) for new players.

Van Hooydonk, Celtic's top scorer last season with 26 goals, has been unsettled at Parkhead this season despite scoring 16 times. He has lost his regular first team place to Portugal's Jorge Cadete, Celtic's current top scorer with 28.
If Forest do complete the signing, the Dutchman could play against Blackburn Rovers in a league match on Tuesday night.
